title: Titanium Craniofacial Mesh
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Craniofacial Mesh where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Reconstruction mesh for craniofacial repair (CP-Ti) requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by reconstruction mesh for craniofacial repair (cp-ti) and specific design requirements.
